messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] Problems with rNOMADS package
messages.body_plain:
HI !,

It is a pleasure to connect with you.
Well, I have some problems to rNOMADS package, when I want to compile the
following line:

>   model.urls <- GetDODSDates("gfs_0p50")
give an error

*Error in if (grepl("grib filter", grib.filter.tmp)) { :  argumento tiene
longitud cero*
I tried to fix this problem by myself but I did not have any success,
could you help me please?
Decker

messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] rNOMADS grib broken, grads-dods fixed
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

As you may have noticed, the NOMADS website had some changes and that
broke rNOMADS.  I've gotten the dods utility back up and running, but
grib may take a little while longer. The website structure is actually
better, I just have to rewrite some code.

If you need the DODS capability, please email me at
danny.c.bowman at gmail.com and I'll send you a beta version.  I'm going
to work on grib tonight and will send a message when I've got that
fixed as well.

Best,

Danny

messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] high impact rNOMADS tasks should be switched from GRIB to DODS
messages.subject_clean: [Rnomads-user] high impact rNOMADS tasks should be switched from GRIB to DODS
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

A quick update.  NOMADS is using dynamically generated content in
their grib interface, which makes it very difficult to scrape.  I have
a possible solution using RSelenium, but it will take me at least a
week to implement and will require the user to install external
programs.

Therefore, I suggest anyone using grib in a critical capacity to
switch to DODS now.  The attached update fixes the issue with DODS
only.

Best,

Danny
